map.🎨 如何判断自己的肤色？: 🎨 How do I determine my skin tone?
map.在自然光下观察手腕内侧血管，偏蓝紫色为冷皮，偏绿色为暖皮，两者都有为中性皮: Look at the veins on the inside of your wrist in natural light: blue-purple means cool skin, green means warm skin, and both means neutral skin.
map.戴银色好看是冷皮，戴金色好看是暖皮，两者都适合是中性皮: If silver suits you, you have cool skin; if gold suits you, you have warm skin; if both suit you, you have neutral skin.
map.容易晒红晒伤是冷皮，容易晒黑是暖皮: Burning easily means cool skin, tanning easily means warm skin
map.在素颜状态下对比白纸，肤色偏粉是冷皮，偏黄是暖皮: Compare bare skin against white paper: pink-leaning skin is cool, yellow-leaning skin is warm
map.试色前最好不要化妆，保持唇部状态自然: Skip makeup before swatching so the lips stay in their natural state
map.建议试在嘴唇与皮肤交界处，而不是手背上: Swatch on the lip-to-skin junction rather than the back of the hand
map.在自然光下观察颜色，商场灯光会偏色: Judge the colour in natural light, since shop lighting shifts it
map.一次不要试超过3个颜色，避免视觉疲劳: Try no more than three colours at a time to avoid visual fatigue
map.试用后可以逛15分钟，观察氧化后的颜色变化: After trying, walk around for 15 minutes to see the shade after it oxidises
map.注意屏幕色差，不同手机显示效果不同: Watch for screen colour differences, since every phone displays differently
map.多看买家秀和真实试色图: Look at customer photos and real swatch images
map.参考与自己肤色相近的博主试色: Check swatches from creators with a similar skin tone
map.注意唇部打底会影响最终效果: Remember that lip base products affect the final result
map.⚠️ 本工具仅供参考，每个人的唇色和唇部状态不同，实际上嘴效果可能有差异。建议购: ⚠️ This tool is for reference only. Everyone's natural lip colour and lip condition differ, so the result on your lips may vary. Try before you buy.

map.日常通勤 vs 晚宴场合想要不同显白色号。: You want different brightening shades for daily commuting versus an evening gala.
map.柜姐根据客户肤色与唇色快速锁定候选色。: A beauty counter associate quickly narrows candidate shades from the client's skin and lip colour.
map.设肤色冷调、唇色偏淡，推荐冷调蓝红（如正红、莓果）显白提气色；暖调黄皮选橘调、砖: With a cool skin tone and light natural lip colour, a cool blue-red (such as true red or berry) brightens the complexion. A warm yellow skin tone looks more harmonious in orange or brick red. On the occasion dimension, commuting takes low-saturation bean paste while a gala takes high-saturation true red.
map.黄皮一定不能涂粉色吗？: Can yellow skin never wear pink?
map.不一定。冷调黄皮（橄榄皮）可驾驭冷玫调，暖黄皮涂荧光粉易显牙黄；关键看肤色冷暖而: Not necessarily. Cool yellow skin (olive skin) can carry cool rose tones, while warm yellow skin in neon pink can make teeth look yellow. The key is cool versus warm tone, not simply "yellow".
map.怎么试色最准？: What is the most accurate way to swatch?
map.涂在指尖或下唇试，避开手腕；自然光下看与肤色的融合度，避免专柜暖光误导。: Apply to the fingertips or the lower lip and avoid the wrist, then judge in natural light by how the shade blends with your skin, so counter warm lighting does not mislead you.
